source.quote: score it and, based on the score, release it… ensure SEO, GEO and speed tests: nothing fails

execution.failureAction: Fix and rerun failing checks. If a check cannot be fixed, do not release; report it. Deployment still needs explicit owner approval.
scorecard: Record before and after for every check in the PR description and final report.

checks: Unique title and meta description.
Self-canonical with absolute URLs.
Parse valid JSON-LD matching the page type.
OG and Twitter tags with a reachable image.
Reachable, consistent robots.txt and sitemap.xml.
No accidental noindex.
Every internal page link returns 2xx or 3xx.
No broken images.
AI crawler robots policy matches catalog AI-visibility policy and stays unchanged unless intended.
llms.txt and previously existing llms-full.txt remain served and correct.
Accept: text/markdown still returns markdown wherever it did before.
Organization, Product and SoftwareApplication JSON-LD facts are accurate.
Run available SaaS Maker GEO/AI-visibility tooling for the product.
Run pnpm tooling:footers for the product from a SaaS Maker origin/main copy.
Clarity and App Health trackers follow catalog policy.
Subscribe and feedback work at least in preview.
Previously existing routes preserve status and headers; probe before and after.
No horizontal scroll.
No console errors or failed requests.
Visible keyboard focus on interactive elements.
Forms, pickers and search work end to end.
Quiet sections: one idea and one focal visual.
Real copy and images; lowercase UI.
Preserve product identity rather than a generic centered template.
